overview: UniDigital is a comprehensive, enterprise-grade, fully paperless university portal automating and digitizing all academic, administrative, and financial processes from admission to graduation. The platform features role-based dashboards, full CRUD for student and staff profiles, JAMB admission portal management, institution-adaptive academic records, results processing, CBT exams, payroll, bursary, and much more.
features: JAMB Admission Portal with full CRUD (add/edit/delete/search/filter)
Student Profile Portal with photo capture and editing
Staff Profile Portal with photo capture and editing
Role-based dashboards (Admin, HOD, Lecturer, Student, Bursary, HR)
Full result processing pipeline with multi-level approval
CBT exams, payroll, bursary, attendance tracking
ID card generation with webcam capture
